text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Now for the explanation of today's course.
The starting point is
Bubblyland. All four
segments are connected by a relay, ending
at
Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The first segment is swimming. Athletes
must make a round trip
through a wave
pool. Adaptability will be key!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Second is the mission run. Athletes will
have to complete a mission
before they
can start running in this segment.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The mission has just been announced!
Runners will have to add their
own
flavoring to a plain sports drink!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The third segment is cycling. The route has
many ups and downs,
eventually splitting
into three paths that traverse a mountain.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The shortest but steepest route goes over
the mountain. The riverside
route is the
longest and goes around the mountain.
The middle route
has rolling hills.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
All three routes converge on the
mountain's downward slope. Route

selection will be crucial in this segment.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And the finale—the anchor leg—is running!
This segment is a circuit
on Tracen
Academy's turf track!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The winning team will be presented with a
plaque from our sponsor
and a luxurious
prize. There will also be a special prize for
the most
exciting team!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Prepare for the fierce battle that these
Tracen Academy students are
about to
fight! The start of the Team Triathlon is
moments away!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Why if it isn't Team Centurial and Team
Muscle.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Centurial is a pretty cool name. It sounds
kinda dystopian, like a
gathering of
demons or something.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to name it "The Centurial
Overlord and Her Delightful
Companions,"
but that was too long to register.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Some of my teammates were of the
opinion that "Overlord" was too
weighty.
And lo, after some parley, we concluded
that "Centurial" was
passable.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um, guys... I think it's about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Spe, don't act like this doesn't
concern you! What even is your
team's
name?! At least try to be creative! Listen,
naming is—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bang!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And there's the starting gun! The athletes
spring into action—but
Gold Ship has yet
to depart!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship appears to be in no hurry to
start! Can she recover from this
setback?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wahoo! I knew a kickboard would be
perfect for surfing the waves!
Behold! My
flawless balance!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In this long lost utopia... allow the
Overlord to breathe new life into a

paradise that faded along with the
bubbles.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, feast your eyes! The Overlord and
her bubbly fairies grace this
tide with their
luster!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What's this? In a strange turn of events,
T.M. Opera O and Gold Ship
are posing on
their kickboards!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I'd love to try surfing myself
someday!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The manufacturer sponsoring this
competition has allowed the use of
certain
equipment—kickboards
included—however...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The two athletes on kickboards have not
made any forward
movement! They are
simply seesawing on the waves!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My, how very uncouth. The beauty of my
pose lies in its stillness.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So it's come down to a duel between you
and me! That special prize is
mine!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sh-should I do something too?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Just keep swimming normally, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
After a chaotic start, we're already nearing
the end of the first part.
The leaders of the
pack are preparing to pass their batons!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O and Gold Ship, who were far
behind, are now closing
the gap with
impressive flutter kicks! Neither is letting
go of their
kickboard!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The first athlete to leave the water is
Special Week! She heads
toward her
team's second racer, Matikanetannhauser!
